rationale: The assistant gave a safe first step (lift off the dock and switch off, then clean the rollers and end caps), which led directly to the fix the customer reported. It was slightly weak on calibration, since it said it couldn't confirm what Error 2 means and never plainly said that Error 2 means the main brushes can't turn. The closing advice was proportionate: new rollers only if they are worn or the error returns, and iRobot support only if the error persists. No part was pushed unnecessarily.
